notes.subject: הגינה
notes.rationale: Daɲɛ n-gɛlɛn: seerebaga-w bɛ o ta tuma-camɛ na — «a ye tilennen ye», «a cogoya bɛ ka ɲi», walima sira-tɔgɔ dɔ dɔrɔn; YLT ni ASV bɛ a to «the wall» la, nka sɛbɛnni-tiɲɛ ma a fɔ dɔko la.

notes.subject: דרך
notes.rationale: Kumasen in kɔnɔ, «derek» daɲɛ bɛ segin tilennen na fila-camɛ na (tan-ni-sin), Bamanankan b'o jira ni sira minnu bɛ tugu ɲɔgɔn bila.

notes.subject: kɛnɛ ma-ko
notes.rationale: Yehezikele ka sarakabɔlan ka jatebolo-yɔrɔ in kɔnɔ, kumasen-w nin bɛ jira yɔrɔ-minnu na ni u da-yɔrɔ-ma-w ye, ni ɲɛfɔli kɔrɔ ye.

translation: Ni so-kɔnɔda-w minnu bɛ jiguiriyɔrɔ fɛ, olu da-yɔrɔ cogoya la, da dɔ tun bɛ sira kun na, sira min bɛ gadẹrẹti ɲɛda la, a bɛ tunkan sira fɛ, ni mɔgɔ bɛ don o so-kɔnɔda-w la.

tokens.gloss: ni mɔgɔ bɛ don olu la
